name: Hinterlands Honey Ripple
summary: Crates of Hinterlands Honey Ripple sit at an abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock. Dran Droffers wants the bottles for a packaging scheme.

sections.title: Crates at Skulk Rock
sections.body: The crates at Skulk Rock hold Hinterlands Honey Ripple, an unusual drink sought by Dran Droffers. The abandoned Horde base lies among slime covered ruins, where the bottles must be gathered with care. Their intact packaging matters to the scheme Dran has in mind.

faq.q: Where can I find Hinterlands Honey Ripple?
faq.answer: Hinterlands Honey Ripple is in crates around the abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock.
Dran Droffers seeks Hinterlands Honey Ripple for a packaging scheme involving Malton’s father.

faq.q: Why does Dran need the bottles intact?
faq.answer: Dran says the bottles must not be bruised because jostling spoils the drink’s bouquet. He has empty packaging for the ripple.
It is a bottled drink kept in crates at the abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock.

angles.text: The bottles lie in crates at an abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock.
